_policy_usage_text.!:
Usage:
  !policy show
  !policy set <text>
  !policy enable
  !policy disable
  !policy clear/delete/remove
  !policy help/usage

Supported placeholders:
  {prefix}, {room}, {room_count}, {admin_room}, {bot_name}
Use literal \n for line breaks.

Usage:
  $>policy show
  $>policy set <text>

  $>policy help/usage

Use literal \n for line breaks.

_protection_usage_text.!:
Usage:
  !protections list [all|page|last]
  !protection enable <name>
  !protection disable <name>
  !protections <name> config/show
  !protections <name> set <key> <value>
  !protections <name> reset
  !protections <name> observe <on|off>
  !protections reporters add/remove/list <jid>

Examples:
  !protection enable FloodSpamProtection
  !protections MentionLimitProtection set max_mentions 5
  !protections FloodSpamProtection set tempban_seconds 1h
  !protections reporters add alice@example.org
_protection_usage_text.$>:
Usage:
  $>protections list [all|page|last]
  $>protection enable <name>
  $>protection disable <name>
  $>protections <name> config/show
  $>protections <name> set <key> <value>
  $>protections <name> reset
  $>protections <name> observe <on|off>
  $>protections reporters add/remove/list <jid>

Examples:
  $>protection enable FloodSpamProtection
  $>protections MentionLimitProtection set max_mentions 5
  $>protections FloodSpamProtection set tempban_seconds 1h
  $>protections reporters add alice@example.org
